cases.script:
# KI-010: Removing the visible sulfur does not remove all unreacted precursor
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 Na2S2O3 0.002mol
add v1 HCl 0.002mol
wait 10s
new
filter v1 v2
inspect
wait 30s
inspect
cases.original_forecast: If acid and thiosulfate remain in the filtrate, fresh sulfur can form there after the original solid is retained in the first vessel.

original_acceptance_checks.criterion: Verify residual acid/thiosulfate in v2 immediately after filtration.
New solid in v2 must be distinguished from transferred old sulfur.

original_limitations: If the initial interval exhausts the acid or a filter transfers colloidal sulfur, the intended contrast is inconclusive.

separate_review_expectations: All donor SO2 gas must remain across filter, liquid/aqueous precursor/acid transfer only, receiver subsequent new sulfur independent of old removed solid, complete S/H/O/Na/Cl/charge, actual time and pH; no calibrated rates/continuousbuffering/false total-atmospheric-credit ownership.
